brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build contains one part only: piece:0,0,0;half-w (current), previously piece:0,0,0;full - no neighboring bases or upper levels.

Configurator offers 0 drawer sockets on a full hex base (tested) and at most 1 drawer on a half base (half-n: 1, half-s: 1, half-e:0, half-w:0). Notch and bay drawer frames require 2-3 adjacent cells per documentation. Five drawers cannot be placed in a single cell; check_build shows no drawer sockets available.

finish.summary: Single base constraint limits drawers to max 1 (half bases) or 0 (full base). Five drawers in one hex requires additional cells that the brief forbids, so configurator refuses the requirement.
